actual_request.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET, a previous EAST walk frame. Images2/3 are original identity and approved painting style. AI-redraw the TWO LEGS and lower hems into a newly articulated pose. Keep head, face, torso, bow, both hands, quiver, all clothing design, camera and canvas scale the same as image1. Keep same cheerful open-mouth expression. Only very mild cloth/hair follow-through. This must be a real new pose, not a shifted/mirrored copy.
POSE requested EAST frame12/16: right early support. Anatomical RIGHT leg is nearer camera: flat planted closer to body root as torso advances. Anatomical LEFT leg is farther: swinging forward toward planted foot, knee flexed. Body rising toward neutral. Always one supporting foot, no flying or running. Reference1 right supporting leg must remain supporting until weight transfers. Draw correct separate knees and boots. Travel is screen RIGHT in exact side profile, no yaw rotation. Transparent RGBA background and clean alpha edges, no shadow, no text. Full figure and longbow inside margins. Native output at least1024x1024 square. Highest available quality.
Reference2 identity must not change; original green eyes, brown bamboo-leaf ponytail, green ivory gold robe and short pants, jade ornaments. Left hand holds long bow, near right hand is free. Keep original painting style from reference3.
